articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally turned GitHub into their personal AWS key dumping ground, exposing GovCloud credentials like it's amateur hour. Congress is rightfully losing their minds over America's cybersecurity agency getting owned by basic OpSec failures.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: A CISA contractor casually left AWS GovCloud keys on public GitHub because apparently security through obscurity died and nobody told them. The cybersecurity agency got cybersecurity'd by their own contractor's spectacular GitHub fail.

articles.title: More License Plate Reader Mission Creep: School Residency Verification, Background Checks, and Noise Complaints
articles.summary: Age verification laws are turning into a surveillance state wet dream, forcing everyone to doxx themselves to protect the children™. EFF correctly identifies this as the privacy nightmare it obviously is.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: License plate readers have evolved from crime fighting to full-spectrum life stalking, now used for school residency checks and noise complaints. Because nothing says 'freedom' like having your every movement tracked for the most mundane bureaucratic purposes.

articles.title: Snowflake buys Natoma to help freeze out rogue agents
articles.summary: Disgruntled researcher promises Microsoft a 'bone shattering drop' of six zero-days after feeling 'humiliated' by Redmond's response. This is what happens when you piss off someone who literally holds the keys to your kingdom.

articles.title: Threat Actors Exploit Critical FortiClient EMS Flaw to Deploy Credential Stealer
articles.summary: Critical RCE in Gogs Git service lets any authenticated user execute arbitrary code with a CVSS 9.4 rating. Self-hosted Git just became self-pwned Git for anyone running this popular repository manager.

articles.title: ThreatsDay Bulletin: Claude Security Plugin, Azure Priv-Esc, Kali365 MFA Bypass, FIFA Scams +15 More
articles.summary: Microsoft removes researcher's GitHub account then lectures everyone about 'responsible disclosure' like they're the victims. Peak corporate gaslighting: silence the messenger, then complain about the message delivery method.

articles.title: Disgruntled 0-day hunter 'humiliated' by Microsoft pledges 'bone shattering drop' as Redmond calls cops
articles.summary: Military personnel's smartphones leaked location data to foreign adversaries because apparently OPSEC training doesn't cover commercial tracking. DoD finally realizes that maybe soldiers shouldn't be broadcasting their positions via Candy Crush.

articles.title: Microsoft Slams Public Zero-Day Disclosures Amid GitHub Researcher Account Removal
articles.summary: Threat actors exploit critical FortiClient EMS flaw to turn endpoint management into malware delivery infrastructure. Nothing quite like having your security solution become the very thing it was supposed to protect against.

articles.title: Kimsuky Deploys HTTPSpy, Expands Arsenal with HelloDoor and VS Code Tunnels
articles.summary: ShinyHunters sailed away with 6 million Carnival customer records in April breach, proving that cruise ship security is about as watertight as their reputation. Another day, another massive breach from the gift that keeps on giving.
